clips.send: Medical teams abroad (Algeria, 1963). Doctors sent abroad for 60 years. China sent its first medical team to Algeria in 1963. Since then teams have worked in more than 70 countries, mostly in Africa, treating about 290 million patients (figure as of 2023). During COVID-19 China sent medical supplies and vaccines to many countries.

clips.send: The phone in your pocket was probably designed in one country, built from parts made in a dozen others, and put together in China. What does that tell you about the world today? Chinese ninth-graders spend a semester on this question: how the world is tied together, which problems no country can solve alone, and what part China plays. Click the map, drag through the years and see for yourself.

clips.send: After World War II the US funded the Marshall Plan to rebuild Europe, and today it finances roads, ports and power abroad through its own agencies and partnerships. Views of the Belt and Road differ: China’s textbook presents it as open, win-win cooperation; some US officials and scholars voice concerns about debt and influence. Comparing sources is a good exercise.
